premise: Ladybug counts her spots, Bee's stripes and Flower's petals, then her friends, and takes her proudest bow at the end.
inspiration: The folk counting rhyme, turned so the biggest count is not of things but of friends, and the friends count her back.
lesson: Friends are the best thing to count.

en-US.title: Ladybug Counts Her Friends
en-US.text: {ladybug:enter} Ladybug came walking through the grass, {ladybug:face happy} counting as she went. [excited] First, her own spots! One, two, three, four, five. {ladybug:hop} Five black spots! {bee:enter} {bee:float loop 0.4} Bee {sfx:buzz} came buzzing down. [giggles] Count me next! she said. {bee:live} She took a deep breath, hummed a happy tune with her eyes closed, then danced a wiggly dance to show her stripes. One stripe, two stripes. {bee:sparkle} Two! Next, the {flower:enter} flower's petals. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight {flower:face happy} {flower:wobble} yellow petals! Then Ladybug tried the biggest count of all. {ladybug:face surprised} [curious] How many friends do I have? Bee, one. Flower, two. {butterfly:enter} Butterfly fluttered by. Three! {ladybug:face happy} [happily] Three friends! {ladybug:live} Ladybug lifted her red wing cases, spread her thin wings and fluttered, folded them away… and took a very proud bow. [softly] And her friends {bee:hearts} {flower:hearts} counted back: one little ladybug. {ladybug:glow} The very best one.

es-ES.title: Mariquita cuenta a sus amigos
es-ES.text: {ladybug:enter} Mariquita llegó andando por la hierba, {ladybug:face happy} contando por el camino. [excited] ¡Primero, sus lunares! Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco. {ladybug:hop} ¡Cinco lunares negros! {bee:enter} {bee:float loop 0.4} Abeja {sfx:buzz} bajó zumbando. [giggles] ¡Ahora cuéntame a mí!, dijo. {bee:live} Tomó aire, tarareó una canción alegre con los ojos cerrados y luego bailó meneándose para enseñar sus rayas. Una raya, dos rayas. {bee:sparkle} ¡Dos! Después, los pétalos de la {flower:enter} flor. Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco, seis, siete, ocho {flower:face happy} {flower:wobble} ¡pétalos amarillos! Entonces Mariquita probó la cuenta más grande de todas. {ladybug:face surprised} [curious] ¿Cuántos amigos tengo? Abeja, una. Flor, dos. {butterfly:enter} Mariposa pasó revoloteando. ¡Tres! {ladybug:face happy} [happily] ¡Tres amigas! {ladybug:live} Mariquita levantó sus alas rojas, abrió las alitas finas de debajo y las agitó, las guardó… e hizo una reverencia muy orgullosa. [softly] Y sus amigas {bee:hearts} {flower:hearts} la contaron a ella: una mariquita pequeñita. {ladybug:glow} La mejor de todas.

buzz.prompt: a friendly bee buzzing down to land on a flower
